snippet.title: Civ Tour: Qajar | Civilization VII
snippet.description:
Emerge into modernity as Qajar. Add the Qajar civilization to your collection for the Modern Age next week in Civilization VII!

► Get Civ 7 today: https://2kgam.es/Civ7
► Link your 2K Account to unlock Napoleon in Civ 7: https://2kgam.es/Napoleon
► Visit the Game Guide for more on each leader and civ: https://2kgam.es/Civ7GameGuide

---------------------------------
HISTORY
---------------------------------
Out of the chaos of the eighteenth century, the Qajars emerged to lead Iran into modernity. Their tenure oversaw the growth of cities, the construction of grand palaces, and an artistic renaissance merging old and new mediums. Amid a rapidly globalizing world, the Qajars played a furious game of diplomacy with European powers that delayed critical growth. Yet major reforms transformed the nation's identity, giving rise to a new Iran.

---------------------------------
ABILITY
---------------------------------
Kayānī Crown: Increased Influence toward Supporting Diplomatic Actions.

---------------------------------
ATTRIBUTES
---------------------------------
- Expansionist
- Diplomatic

---------------------------------
CIVIC TREES
---------------------------------
The Sun Throne
- Tier 1: Unlocks the Takyeh Unique Building, the 'Soleymaniyeh Palace' Tradition, and the Eram Garden Wonder.
- Tradition - Soleymaniyeh Palace: Increased Influence for every Population in the Capital.
- Tier 2: When you Support an Endeavor, receive a set amount of Culture while the other leader receives a set amount of Gold (Yields scale based on game speed).

Twelve Gates
- Tier 1: Unlocks the Ghahve Khane Unique Building and the 'Waqāyeʿ-e Ettefāqiya' Tradition.
- Tradition - Waqāyeʿ-e Ettefāqiya: Increased Science and Culture in the Capital based on the number of Settlements you have fewer than your Settlement Limit.
- Tier 2: Increased Food and Production in the Capital based on the number of Settlements you have fewer than your Settlement Limit.

Neẓām-e J̌adīd
- Tier 1: Increased Combat Strength to Land Combat Units based on the number of Settlements you have fewer than your Settlement Limit. Unlocks the 'Qullarāqāsi' Tradition.
- Tradition - Qullarāqāsi: Commander Units that are Stationed on a District provide increased Happiness.

---------------------------------
INFRASTRUCTURE
---------------------------------
Bāq: Unique Quarter. Increased Influence and Culture in this Settlement during Celebrations.

Takyeh: Unique Building. Happiness Base. Gain Influence adjacency bonus with Culture Buildings.

Ghahve Khaneh: Unique Building. Food Base. Gain Happiness adjacency bonus with Gold Buildings.

---------------------------------
CIVILIAN UNIT
---------------------------------
Sardār: Unique Commander Unit. Increased Movement. Raze a set number of additional Districts per turn in Settlements with this Commander.

---------------------------------
MILITARY UNIT
---------------------------------
Gholām: Unique Cavalry Unit. Increased Combat Strength and HP healing in Command Radius of a Sardār Unique Civilian Unit.

---------------------------------
WONDER
---------------------------------
Eram Garden: Food Base. Increased Specialist Limit in this City. Must be placed on a Desert tile.

---------------------------------
STARTING BIAS
---------------------------------
- Plains
- Desert

---------------------------------
GAMEPLAY TIP
---------------------------------
Qajar benefits from being below the Settlement Limit. Keep an eye on how many Settlements you have to make the most of their bonuses!

*This civilization is now available as a separate purchase (base game required). If you own the Right to Rule Collection DLC bundle or Sid Meier's Civilization VII Founders Edition, then you already own this content.
